title: The Broken Script: Moonfall
description: Enter an ARG experience and discover the mysteries of a corrupted world.
body:

- Source: archive recovered from ~~T̷̢͈̪͉̞̗̖͓̖̗͔̲̊͐͂̌̃͛͌͋̚͝ẖ̶̭̖̂̽͛͜e̴̬̬̤̜͓̪̒̉̑̂͗̈͌̌̽͛̚͠ ̷̧͓̪͙̜̭̩͎̪̙͌̅̊̓͗̑̓̉̀̾̑́̌͜ͅṼ̵̡̢̙̳͓̓͝o̸͍̅̇̔͗̊̀͑͛̂̓͠͝͝i̵̧͕͉̦̭̗̤͗͊͊̈̅͌d̷̨̢̛̤̘̖̥͇̯̞͈͙͋̾~~

An old branch of Minecraft Alpha that does not appear in any known official history. Visually, everything seems normal: old fog, silence, simple terrain, period-accurate interface, just a buggy menu. But something is wrong...

                                                Nothing is watching
                                                   There's nothing to discover
                                                      Just keep playing.
                                                          D̴̗͝Ő̷̻N̵̨̈́'̵̫́T̷̯̊ ̵̣̒Ṣ̵͘T̴͕̀O̸̧͘P̸̗̏!̴̥̀
### The Broken Script: Moonfall

The world they built. The world they hate.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/purgl-2pDM0" title="Lanceur de vidéo YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
THINGS YOU WANT TO KNOW BEFORE PLAYING

- Mods WILL    ban you from your world eventually.
- Mods WILL crash the game.
- Mods can create .TXT files on your desktop.
- Mods can shake your game window.
- Mods can create custom error popups on your desktop.
- Mods WILL grief your world.
- Mods WILL destroy your buildings.
- I do not recommend playing with shaders that change skybox (Certain events will break) 
-  THIS MODPACK HAS LOUD SOUNDS !
-  THIS MODPACK HAS FLASHING LIGHTS WITH NO WAY TO DISABLE !


This horror modpack slowly corrupts your world and slowly turns everything chaotic. The moon will slowly start to disappear and chaos will come. Entities will start spawning and this modpack will have you on the edge of your seat, as they wait for the perfect time to strike.

TBS: Moonfall is a (VERY) slow horror modpack that will try to make you feel paranoid. There are random events, few entities and anomalies (and much more)

To access the config open the modpack files then go to config and then look for what you want to change.
